description_en: Calls the DetachResourceFromVpcEndpointService operation to remove a service resource from an endpoint service
description_zh: 调用DetachResourceFromVpcEndpointService接口，移除终端节点服务中的服务资源
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink detach-resource-from-vpc-endpoint-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id lb-hp32z1wp5peaoox2q0000 --service-id epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachResourceFromVpcEndpointService

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the endpoint service from which you want to remove a service resource. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 要移除服务资源的终端节点服务所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the service resource. Valid values:

slb: Classic Load Balancer (CLB).

alb: Application Load Balancer (ALB).

nlb: Network Load Balancer (NLB).
gwlb: Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB)
parameters.help_zh:
服务资源的类型。

slb：表示服务资源类型为传统型负载均衡CLB（Classic Load Balancer）。

alb：表示服务资源类型为应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）。

nlb：表示服务资源类型为网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer ）。
gwlb : 表示服务资源类型为网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The zone of the endpoint service from which you want to remove a service resource. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the region ID. ZoneId is required when the service resource type is ALB, NLB, or GWLB
parameters.help_zh: 要移除服务资源的终端节点服务所属的可用区。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。服务资源为ALB/NLB/GWLB时，ZoneId为需要填写
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint service from which you want to remove a service resource
parameters.help_zh: 要移除服务资源的终端节点服务的ID
parameters.name: service_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without removing the service resource. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会移除服务资源。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
